verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API with self-serve API key generation (multiple named keys per application). It exposes list endpoints for recordings, notes and action items with cursor pagination. Recordings carry diarized, timestamped transcripts through an `include` parameter and represent the meeting recap, and the docs explicitly frame passing transcripts to an LLM as a use case. Missing for 10: summaries are only implied through 'meeting recap'/'structured notes' rather than shown as an explicit API field; workspace-wide 'every meeting' access appears to need Enterprise Super Admin keys; no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404); no independent or hands-on corroboration.
